source_note: Windmemories 2025 实拍内院。照片不提供具体院号，标题不擅定某号院或最高上房。首稿砖纹较密且上缘截断，第二次内置 image_gen 删除砖纹并留白。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Refine the existing Kang Baiwan Manor courtyard drawing in image 3 using the actual photograph in image 2. Keep the correct two-story central brick cave-house facade with lower arched door, upper arched window, horizontal perforated parapet, flanking inward-facing domestic walls and small balustrade returns. IMPORTANT COMPOSITION CHANGE: SHRINK the entire scene so ALL ink strokes are within a large blank white margin of at least 130 pixels on EVERY side of the 1536x1024 canvas. Do NOT allow the upper side-wall eaves or any stroke to touch the top edge. Treat it as an isolated courtyard VIGNETTE with incomplete side-wall outlines fading out well inside the white margin; do not invent roofs beyond the photo. SIMPLIFICATION: DELETE every all-over brick grid and every all-over paving grid; walls must be completely plain WHITE. Keep only 3 short local stone joints near doorway edges and about 4 paving contour segments below the steps. Remove the solid black cross hole fills: represent six or eight parapet cross-shaped openings with very fine empty outlines, no black fills. Thin all lines and reduce the number of window lattice bars. Main silhouettes delicate, secondary details much finer. No text, no trees, no ornament not in the actual photograph. Maintain the identifiable spatial layout but with the spacious sparse contour-line language of image 1. Landscape 1536x1024, complete isolated vignette, 13 percent minimum pure white margins.

historical_sources.supports: 明末清初断代、庄园位置、楼房与窑洞结合、院落格局

historical_sources.title: 郑州日报／郑州市人民政府：康百万庄园，长盛密码自留余
historical_sources.supports: 17—18 世纪庄园建筑、现存主宅区与多代续建

site_recommendation.name: 康百万庄园
site_recommendation.era: 明末清初 · 历代续建
site_recommendation.yearNote: 郑州市文物局整体断代明末清初，后世持续营建。1700 仅为庄园明清遗构的近似排序点；照片所示窑楼尚无单体确切营建年，不将康氏迁居或个人生卒年当建筑纪年。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 郑州市巩义市
site_recommendation.lede: 窑楼立面与两侧楼房围成深长内院。康百万庄园把依崖筑窑与四合院住宅结合，留下河洛商人家族的居住空间。

facts.label: 庄园年代
facts.text: 郑州市文物局将庄园断代为明末清初；它经过康氏家族多代营建，现存院落并非同年建成。

facts.label: 地方形制
facts.text: 庄园靠崖筑窑洞、临街建楼房，住宅庭院采用四合院格局，结合木、砖、石构件。

facts.label: 图版范围
facts.text: 以实拍内院为依据，表现上下拱形开口的窑楼正面与两侧内向房屋；周边不完整墙面留白收束，不补画隐蔽外观。
